name: file-upload
title: File Upload
description: A drop zone with an upload queue: drop, paste or browse, watch progress per file, cancel or retry. Simulated locally unless you pass onUpload.

props.name: onUpload
props.type: (file: File, helpers: { onProgress: (percent: number) => void; signal: AbortSignal }) => Promise<void>
props.description: Uploads one file. Resolve to finish the row, reject to show an error with Retry. Omit to simulate uploads locally.

props.name: onUploadSuccess
props.description: Called when one file finishes uploading.

props.name: onUploadError
props.description: Called for validation errors and failed uploads.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called with all uploaded files once nothing is queued or in flight.

props.name: onFileRemove
props.description: Called when a row is removed, cancelling its upload if needed.

props.name: acceptedFileTypes
props.description: MIME types, wildcards like image/* or extensions like .pdf. Empty accepts anything.

props.name: maxFileSize
props.description: Maximum size of each file in bytes.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Maximum number of files in the list.

props.name: uploadDelay
props.description: Simulated upload duration per file in milliseconds, used without onUpload.

props.name: simulateFailure
props.description: Simulated uploads only: the first attempt of every third file fails.

props.name: validateFile
props.description: Extra validation. Return an error to reject the file.
